items.text: Uses a single system font stack for everything, with no web fonts loaded.

items.text: The palette is limited to white, peach rgb(255,170,145), a pale peach tint rgb(255,241,236), and a dark charcoal rgb(32,39,44).
Body text is dark charcoal rather than black, and secondary text is a mid grey.

features.statement: All text uses a single system font stack with no web fonts loaded.
Short, thick accent-colored underline bar sits left-aligned beneath each section heading.
Palette is restricted to white, one warm peach accent, a pale peach tint, and dark charcoal.
Body text is dark charcoal rather than pure black, with mid-grey for secondary text.
Sections alternate between white and pale tinted backgrounds to separate content bands.
Header is a white bar with left logo, a few text nav links, and a text login plus pill signup on the right.
Primary calls to action are fully rounded pill buttons in the accent color, often implemented as styled links.
Hero features a full-width photo background with soft grey wash and a pill-shaped search bar with inset accent button.
Content sits in a centered fixed-width container, narrower than the viewport.
Category links are a multi-column grid of pale tinted rounded tiles with bold labels.
How-it-works section shows a row of white cards with numbered accent-colored circle badges and short sentences.
Cards are white with thin border, rounded corners, and a short accent bar on top above a bold title.
Cards pair a small uppercase letter-spaced grey category label with a bold item name below.
Card grids are long with partially filled last rows and uneven card heights from varying text lengths.
A dark charcoal promotional card with centered white text, decorative accent graphic and accent pill button provides contrast.
Footer uses a curved-crop photo with halftone-dot accent decoration, text-only social links with accent underlines, and a small repeated logo with copyright.
Heading hierarchy is shallow, with H4s used for footer column headings and one H3 for a promo card.
Decorative images have empty alt text and no images lack alt attributes.
Corners are mostly square, with cards and tiles using moderate 8–15px radii and pills for buttons.
Visual style is flat, with almost no shadows, gradients, blur, animations or transforms.
Layout relies on flexbox and some CSS grid, with a single inline style block and no utility framework.
Bold text is used heavily for names and labels, with little paragraph prose.
Review excerpts are quoted and truncated with an ellipsis, followed by the reviewer's name in grey.
Long product names are shown verbatim including size and variant strings, giving a catalogue-like list-heavy feel.
Page title follows a 'Brand – tagline' pattern with concise, plain-spoken community-oriented copy.
The page is long and vertically stacked with many sequential sections.
Page ships with no JavaScript and no structured data.
A third-party banner advertisement is inserted between content sections.
Logo is an SVG wordmark with one syllable highlighted in the accent color.
